instrucoes_especiais: Gerar APENAS a Página 3 (seção '## PÁGINA 3 — Qual Irmão Chamar?' do prompt.md). As páginas pg1, pg2 e pg4 já existem e NAO devem ser regeneradas. A pg3 agora tem 6 painéis (estrutura atualizada com demonstração de mmc(12,18) por fatoração no painel 5). Usar Bia.png e Max-Min.png de canonicas_path como referência visual para manter consistência com as páginas existentes.

referencia_personagens.descricao: Máx = robô alto verde-escuro #047857 com D dourado no peito e óculos quadrados. Mín = robô menor verde-menta #34D399 com M branco no peito e antenas espirais. Bia = menina 11 anos, cabelo cacheado preto, uniforme azul-marinho.

prompt_folha_personagens:
Character model sheet, comic book style, clean cartoon line art with soft cel shading, white background with subtle mint-green grid.

LEFT COLUMN — character "Máx" in three poses:
- Pose 1 (focused/explaining): tall robust rectangular robot, dark emerald green body (#047857), large golden "D" emblem on chest over lighter green plate, square black glasses, short screwdriver-shaped antennas on head, one finger pointing up like a teacher, calm serious expression.
- Pose 2 (proud/happy): same robot standing tall, chest puffed showing the "D", crescent-moon happy eyes, small imaginary crown floating above head, arms relaxed.
- Pose 3 (thoughtful): same robot with metallic hand on chin, antenna rotating, visible gears spinning through small transparent window in chest, analytical expression.

CENTER-LEFT COLUMN — character "Mín" in three poses:
- Pose 1 (excited): smaller rounder mint-green robot (#34D399), large white "M" emblem on chest, ball-shaped feet, long curly spring antennas with yellow blinking bulbs, holding clipboard with circled answer, star-shaped eyes, jumping slightly.
- Pose 2 (explaining): same small robot pointing at a floating row of numbers "0, 12, 24, 36...", big smile of discovery, focused eyes.
- Pose 3 (surprised): same robot with antennas bent into exclamation marks, wide round eyes, clipboard raised above head, floating "?" symbol.

CENTER-RIGHT COLUMN — side-by-side height comparison: Máx (tall, dark green, "D" on chest) next to Mín (short, mint green, "M" on chest). Mín's head reaches Máx's chest. Both smiling at viewer. They are clearly brother robots.

RIGHT COLUMN — character "Bia": 11-year-old Brazilian girl, curly black shoulder-length hair, light skin, large curious brown eyes, light freckles, navy blue polo school shirt, gray skirt, white sneakers, holding a spiral notebook and pencil, one finger raised in "aha!" gesture.

Style: friendly educational cartoon for 10-year-olds, soft outlines, vibrant but not garish colors, math-themed background elements (tiny ∩ symbols, × signs, equals signs floating subtly).

NO TEXT LABELS on this model sheet other than the "D" and "M" emblems on the robots' chests.
prompt_pg3:
Comic book page, 6 panels, friendly educational cartoon style, vibrant emerald and mint green on light mint background (#ECFDF5).

PANEL 1 (wide, top): Bia holds two problem cards. Máx and Mín stand behind her, both raising hands eagerly.
Card 1 (Portuguese, on left): "Uma quadra de vôlei mede 1440 mm × 840 mm. Qual o MAIOR tamanho de trama (lado de quadrado) para cobrir sem sobras?"
Card 2 (Portuguese, on right): "Dois pilotos voam a cada 4 e 5 dias. Em quantos dias eles voarão juntos novamente?"
Speech bubble Bia (Portuguese): "Qual problema é do Máx e qual é do Mín?"

PANEL 2 (medium, left): Visual of a volleyball court rectangle (1440 mm × 840 mm) being divided into a grid of equal small squares. The squares fit perfectly with no leftover space.
Caption (Portuguese, bold): "Problema 1 — Cobrir sem sobras = dividir em partes iguais."
Speech bubble Máx (Portuguese, proud): "Esse é meu! Quando o problema pede 'dividir em partes iguais SEM SOBRAS' ou 'o MAIOR valor que cabe certinho', é mdc!"

PANEL 3 (medium, right): Máx at blackboard showing factorization:
"1440 = 2⁵ × 3² × 5"
"840 = 2³ × 3 × 5 × 7"
"mdc(1440, 840) = 2³ × 3 × 5 = 120"
The number 120 is glowing gold.
Speech bubble Máx (Portuguese): "Lado da trama = 120 mm. Cabe certinho na quadra!"

PANEL 4 (medium, left): Visual of a calendar with two airplanes circling — Piloto A flies every 4 days (highlighted dates: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20...), Piloto B every 5 days (dates: 5, 10, 15, 20...). The date "20" has BOTH planes overlapping with a sparkle.
Caption (Portuguese, bold): "Problema 2 — Coincidência de eventos cíclicos."
Speech bubble Mín (Portuguese, excited): "Esse é meu! Quando o problema pede 'quando dois eventos COINCIDEM de novo' ou 'o MENOR número múltiplo de vários', é mmc!"

PANEL 5 (large, center): Mín at the blackboard solving mmc(12, 18) step by step. Each step is numbered with a small green circle (1, 2, 3, 4).
Blackboard content:
"① Fatorar cada número:"
"   12 = 2² × 3"
"   18 = 2 × 3²"
"② Pegar TODOS os fatores (comuns e não-comuns): 2 e 3"
"③ Usar o MAIOR expoente de cada: 2² e 3²"
"④ mmc(12, 18) = 2² × 3² = 4 × 9 = 36"
The number 36 glows bright green. A small verification badge shows: "36 ÷ 12 = 3 ✓  •  36 ÷ 18 = 2 ✓"
Speech bubble Mín (Portuguese, explaining): "Atenção! 12 e 18 NÃO são primos entre si — então preciso fatorar para achar o mmc!"
Speech bubble Bia (Portuguese, writing in notebook): "Maiores expoentes... anotei!"

PANEL 6 (wide, bottom): Final scene — Máx and Mín hold up a giant golden rule scroll between them. Bia gives a thumbs up.
Scroll content (Portuguese, large bold text):
"REGRA DOS IRMÃOS
• Dividir em grupos iguais sem sobras → Máx (mdc) — fatores COMUNS, menores expoentes
• Coincidir eventos / menor comum → Mín (mmc) — TODOS os fatores, maiores expoentes"
Speech bubble Máx (Portuguese): "Se os números são primos entre si, mmc = produto direto. Senão, fatore!"
Speech bubble Bia (Portuguese): "Agora sim ficou claro!"

All speech bubbles in Brazilian Portuguese. Math notation (², ×, ÷, mdc, mmc) clean and bold. No English text inside panels.
